He also battles his bullies, who have become villains like the Ice Princess. - Taylor Lautner, Taylor Dooley, Cayden Boyd, George Lopez, David Arquette (Children, Adventure, Action, Fantasy)

programme.desc: The Wild Thornberrys feature film finds one of America's favorite animated families going on wild adventures around the world. Now, 12-year-old Eliza is in Africa where she meets a mysterious shaman who grants her the power to talk to animals. But there's a catch -- if she reveals her gift she will lose it forever. One day Eliza discovers that poachers plan to kill an elephant herd with an electrified fence and she and Darwin, her pet chimp, must stop them. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Star Trek Generations
programme.desc: In the 23rd century, the Starship Enterprise is dispatched to the scene of a giant energy field about to engulf two ships. Capt. Kirk (William Shatner) averts calamity, but is exposed to the field and presumed dead. Years later, the Enterprise's new commander, Capt. Picard (Patrick Stewart), learns that one of the disaster's survivors, Dr. Soran (Malcolm McDowell), plans to enter the field by destroying a neighboring star. Picard now must collaborate with an unlikely ally in order to stop him. - Patrick Stewart, William Shatner, Malcolm McDowell, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Adventures of Tintin
programme.desc: While shopping at an outdoor market, young reporter Tintin (Jamie Bell), accompanied by his faithful dog, Snowy, buys a model of an old ship called the Unicorn. A shady character named Sakharine (Daniel Craig) and later an American named Barnaby (Joe Starr) try to buy the model from him, but Tintin refuses. The lad discovers that the ship contains a clue about a hidden treasure, but before he can locate it, Tintin is kidnapped and given over to the custody of drunken Capt. Haddock (Andy Serkis). (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Mystery)

programme.title: Bad News Bears
programme.desc: Morris Buttermaker is a burned-out minor league baseball player who loves to drink and can't keep his hands to himself. His long-suffering lawyer arranges for him to manage a local Little League team, and Buttermaker soon finds himself the head of a rag-tag group of misfit players. Through unconventional team-building exercises and his offbeat coaching style, Buttermaker helps his hapless Bears prepare to meet their rivals, the Yankees. - Billy Bob Thornton, Greg Kinnear, Marcia Gay Harden, Sammi Kane Kraft, Ridge Canipe (Comedy)

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity. - John Cusack, Kate Beckinsale, Molly Shannon, Jeremy Piven, John Corbett (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Down to Earth
programme.desc: When amateur comedian Lance Barton (Chris Rock) finds himself at Heaven's door, he is convinced there has been a mistake. Miraculously he is right. Since returning to his own body is not an option, a heavenly agent places him into the corpse of a rich Manhattan mogul who has just been murdered by his wife -- until a more suitable replacement can be found. Ironically, it is as this new person that Lance ultimately discovers his true self, falls in love and improves his comedy act in the process. - Chris Rock, Regina King, Chazz Palminteri, Eugene Levy, Frankie Faison (Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Drama)

However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world. - Harrison Ford, Cate Blanchett, Shia La Beouf, Karen Allen, Ray Winstone (Adventure, Action)

The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil. - Idris Elba, Matthew McConaughey, Tom Taylor, Claudia Kim, Fran Kranz (Fantasy, Action, Adventure, Science fiction)

Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his crew investigate, they uncover the truth about the Federation mission: It was actually a systematic ploy by the Son'a to displace the peaceful inhabitants of Ba'ku. Now Picard and his crew must thwart the plot even while experiencing strange side effects from exposure to the planet's surface. - Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Thriller, Romance)

And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. - Kate Bosworth, Topher Grace, Josh Duhamel, Nathan Lane, Sean Hayes (Romance, Comedy, Adventure)

So he's teaming up with a band of misfits - six friends who were kung fu masters in their youth - to form a soccer team that only he believes has a chance to win a $1 million grand prize. Together, they're going to apply their hidden talents to a whole new game -- and soccer will never be the same. - Stephen Chow, Zhao Wei, Patrick Tse, Cecilia Cheung, Karen Mok (Family, Comedy, Action)

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board. - Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Lloyd Bridges, Peter Graves, William Shatner (Science fiction, Dark comedy)

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: A smart high-school student with his heart set on going to Stanford is horrified when his guidance counselor accidentally sends the wrong transcript with his college application. He spends the rest of the film trying to prove that he's actually a good student with a terrific grade-point average. - Colin Hanks, Jack Black, Catherine O'Hara, Schuyler Fisk, John Lithgow (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: The Girl in the Pool
programme.desc: A man's life collapses when his mistress is found dead in his pool. Terrified of the consequences and desperate to protect his family, he conceals the truth, triggering a chaotic night that threatens to unravel his perfect life. - Freddie Prinze Jr., Monica Potter, Kevin Pollak, Tyler Lawrence Gray, Brielle Barbusca (Thriller)

programme.title: Stop-Loss
programme.desc: His tour of duty in Iraq finally over, Staff Sgt. Brandon King returns home to Brazos, Texas, ready to re-enter civilian life. Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma. - Ryan Phillippe, Abbie Cornish, Channing Tatum, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Ciarán Hinds (Drama, War)

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: U.S. Navy pilot Lt. Jake Grafton (Brad Johnson) and his bombardier buddy, Lt. Cmdr. Virgil Cole (Willem Dafoe), are two soldiers embedded in the Vietnam War growing frustrated by the military's constraints on their missions. Despite the best efforts of their commanding officer, Cmdr. Frank Camparelli (Danny Glover), to re-engage them, this disillusioned pair decide to take the war effort into their own hands with an explosive battle plan that could well get them court-martialed. - Danny Glover, Willem Dafoe, Brad Johnson, Rosanna Arquette, Tom Sizemore (War, Historical drama)

programme.desc: In 1965 Saigon, disc jockey Adrian Cronauer turns Armed Forces Radio on its ear with his irreverent brand of humor.

programme.title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Dignified Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) joins his wild nephew in a Sicilian vendetta involving the Vatican.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: A mercenary (Sylvester Stallone) and his men learn that their assignment to overthrow a South American dictator is a suicide mission.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Mercenary Barney Ross and his team cut a swath of destruction through opposing forces as they take revenge for the vicious murder of a comrade.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Years ago, Barney Ross co-founded the Expendables with Conrad Stonebanks. After Stonebanks became an arms dealer, Ross was forced to kill him -- or so he thought. Now, Stonebanks is back, and he's on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross decides that the way to fight old blood is with new blood, so he assembles a team of younger, faster, more tech-savvy recruits. The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise. - Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham, Antonio Banderas, Jet Li, Wesley Snipes (Action, Thriller, Adventure)

programme.title: Expend4bles
programme.desc: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table. - Jason Statham, Sylvester Stallone, Andy Garcia, Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson, Megan Fox (Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: In the late 1980s, Ace (Wood Harris) is a young man employed by a Harlem dry cleaning shop, working hard to stay out of the drug business. While making deliveries, he meets Lulu (Esai Morales), a drug dealer who convinces Ace to join him. Ace recruits his friends Mitch (Mekhi Phifer) and Rico (Cam'ron), and the trio become major players in the Harlem drug underworld, a violent business that will test the friends' loyalty and wits as the money rolls in and the dangers grow beyond their control. - Wood Harris, Mekhi Phifer, Kevin Carroll, Esai Morales, Chi McBride (Crime drama)

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Seasoned adventurer Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) sets out for the African desert with his sarcastic companion (Steve Zahn) in search of a ship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up. - Matthew McConaughey, Steve Zahn, Penélope Cruz, Lambert Wilson, Glynn Turman (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon
programme.desc: On April 20, 2010, the Deepwater Horizon drilling rig explodes in the Gulf of Mexico, igniting a massive fireball that kills several crew members. Chief electronics technician Mike Williams (Mark Wahlberg) and his colleagues find themselves fighting for survival as the heat and the flames become stifling and overwhelming. Banding together, the co-workers must use their wits to make it out alive amid all the chaos. - Mark Wahlberg, Kurt Russell, Douglas M. Griffin, James DuMont, Joe Chrest (Thriller, Action, Drama, Adventure, Biography)

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Texas, 1875. In a land without justice, where chaos reigns, one legendary man, Leander McNelly (Dylan McDermott), is chosen to lead a group of unlikely heroes. These young men, out-manned and out-gunned, must battle an army of renegade outlaws led by the ruthless John King Fisher (Alfred Molina). Sworn to protect the innocent and the women they love (Rachael Leigh Cook), (Leonor Varela), the Rangers risk their lives to put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland. - James Van Der Beek, Dylan McDermott, Usher Raymond, Ashton Kutcher, Robert Patrick (Western, Adventure)

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Brad Whitaker (Will Ferrell) is a kindhearted radio executive who wants to be the best possible stepfather to his wife's (Linda Cardellini) two children. When her freewheeling ex-husband, Dusty (Mark Wahlberg), breezes back into town, Brad's feeling of insecurity quickly develops into an inferiority complex. As Dusty demonstrates his flair for athletics, home repair and bad-boy charisma, Whitaker finds himself in a no-holds-barred battle to one-up his rival and win the approval of his family. - Will Ferrell, Mark Wahlberg, Linda Cardellini, Thomas Haden Church, Scarlett Estevez (Comedy)

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. - Dwayne Johnson, Billy Bob Thornton, Oliver Jackson-Cohen, Carla Gugino, Maggie Grace (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: A top Marine sniper, Bob Lee Swagger, leaves the military after a mission goes awry and disappears without a trace. Swagger is coaxed back into service after high-profile government officials convince him to help thwart a plot against the President of the United States. Swagger realizes he has been betrayed and becomes the target of a nationwide manhunt. Instead of hiding, he seeks revenge against some of the most powerful and corrupt leaders in the free world. - Mark Wahlberg, Michael Peña, Danny Glover, Kate Mara, Elias Koteas (Action, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: In 1941, Nazi soldiers are slaughtering Eastern European Jews by the thousands. Three brothers, Tuvia (Daniel Craig), Zus (Liev Schreiber) and Asael (Jamie Bell), manage to escape and take refuge in the forest where they played in childhood. Seeking a way to avenge the deaths of their loved ones, the brothers turn their daily struggle for survival into a battle against the Nazis. As news of their exploits spreads, others join the fray, willing to risk their lives for even brief freedom. - Daniel Craig, Liev Schreiber, Jamie Bell, Alexa Davalos, Allan Corduner (Historical drama, War)

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S. - Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin, Scott Glenn, Sam Neill, James Earl Jones (Thriller, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon
programme.desc: On April 20, 2010, the Deepwater Horizon drilling rig explodes in the Gulf of Mexico, igniting a massive fireball that kills several crew members. Chief electronics technician Mike Williams (Mark Wahlberg) and his colleagues find themselves fighting for survival as the heat and the flames become stifling and overwhelming. Banding together, the co-workers must use their wits to make it out alive amid all the chaos. - Mark Wahlberg, Kurt Russell, Douglas M. Griffin, James DuMont, Joe Chrest (Thriller, Action, Drama, Adventure, Biography)

programme.title: Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: The true story of Pfc. Desmond T. Doss (Andrew Garfield), who won the Congressional Medal of Honor despite refusing to bear arms during WWII on religious grounds. Doss was drafted and ostracized by fellow soldiers for his pacifist stance but went on to earn respect and adoration for his bravery, selflessness and compassion after he risked his life -- without firing a shot -- to save 75 men in the Battle of Okinawa. - Andrew Garfield, Richard Pyros, Jacob Warner, Milo Gibson, Sam Worthington (War, Historical drama, Biography, Docudrama)

programme.title: The General's Daughter
programme.desc: When the body of Army Capt. Elizabeth Campbell (Leslie Stefanson) is found on a Georgia military base, two investigators, Warrant Officers Paul Brenner (John Travolta) and Sara Sunhill (Madeleine Stowe), are ordered to solve her murder. What they uncover is anything but clear-cut. Unseemly details emerge about Campbell's life, leading to allegations of a possible military cover-up of her death and the involvement of her father, Lt. Gen. Joseph Campbell (James Cromwell). - John Travolta, Madeleine Stowe, James Cromwell, Timothy Hutton, Leslie Stefanson (Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war. - Dylan O'Brien, Michael Keaton, Sanaa Lathan, David Suchet, Navid Negahban (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Comeback Trail
programme.desc: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making. - Robert De Niro, Tommy Lee Jones, Morgan Freeman, Zach Braff, Emile Hirsch (Comedy)

programme.title: Heist 88
programme.desc: A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system. - Courtney B. Vance, Keith David, Keesha Sharp, Rebecca Spence, Bentley Green (Crime drama)

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad. - Mel Gibson, Madeleine Stowe, Greg Kinnear, Sam Elliott, Chris Klein (War, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October

Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S. - Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin, Scott Glenn, Sam Neill, James Earl Jones (Thriller, Action, Adventure)

Doss was drafted and ostracized by fellow soldiers for his pacifist stance but went on to earn respect and adoration for his bravery, selflessness and compassion after he risked his life -- without firing a shot -- to save 75 men in the Battle of Okinawa. - Andrew Garfield, Richard Pyros, Jacob Warner, Milo Gibson, Sam Worthington (War, Historical drama, Biography, Docudrama)

Banding together, the co-workers must use their wits to make it out alive amid all the chaos. - Mark Wahlberg, Kurt Russell, Douglas M. Griffin, James DuMont, Joe Chrest (Thriller, Action, Drama, Adventure, Biography)

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: The Silent Planet
programme.desc: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth.

programme.title: Semper Fi
programme.desc: Filmmaker Vince DiPersio documents the experience of Jeff Key, a Marine who served in Iraq while hiding his homosexuality.

programme.title: 2nd Chance
programme.desc: Richard Davis invents a concealable bulletproof vest and shoots himself 196 times over the course of his career to prove the effectiveness of his vests.

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: A beautiful globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) battles otherworldly creatures for possession of a powerful artifact.

programme.title: Uncommon Valor
programme.desc: A colonel with a sponsor leads five Marine veterans into Laos to find his son and others missing in action.

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Two strangers (Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan) become pawns of a mysterious woman who threatens their friends and family and uses technology to control their actions.

programme.title: Virtuosity
programme.desc: An ex-cop doing prison time chases a virtual-reality killer from the program onto the Los Angeles streets.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: Some of the servicemen who raised the U.S. flag on Mount Suribachi during the Battle of Iwo Jima at the end of World War II live to hear of their status as heroes.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, and they join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Reluctantly pressed into service again, a former military sniper plots revenge against his powerful foes after being betrayed and wounded.

programme.title: The Gunman
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. - Sean Penn, Idris Elba, Ray Winstone, Mark Rylance, Javier Bardem (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Uncommon Valor
programme.desc: Col. Cal Rhodes (Gene Hackman), a retired Marine officer, holds out hope that his son, believed to be a prisoner of war in Laos, is still alive. Despite the government's refusal to help Rhodes, he assembles a group to find and rescue his son, including skilled soldiers such as Wilkes (Fred Ward) and Sailor (Randall "Tex" Cobb). Funded by MacGregor (Robert Stack), a wealthy executive also looking for his son, Rhodes leads his men on a dangerous mission into the jungles of Laos. - Gene Hackman, Robert Stack, Fred Ward, Reb Brown, Randall "Tex" Cobb (Action, War)

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them. - Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan, Rosario Dawson, Michael Chiklis, Anthony Mackie (Action, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world. - Angelina Jolie, Jon Voight, Iain Glen, Noah Taylor, Daniel Craig (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Walking Out
programme.desc: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear. - Matt Bomer, Josh Wiggins, Bill Pullman, Alex Neustaedter, Lily Gladstone (Adventure, Drama)

programme.title: Day of the Fight
programme.desc: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure. - Michael C. Pitt, Joe Pesci, Ron Perlman, Steve Buscemi, Nicolette Robinson (Drama)

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down. - Dustin Hoffman, Laurence Olivier, Roy Scheider, William Devane, Marthe Keller (Thriller, Action, Mystery, Drama, War)

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. - Chris Pine, Ben Foster, Gillian Jacobs, Eddie Marsan, JD Pardo (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: U.S. Navy pilot Lt. Jake Grafton (Brad Johnson) and his bombardier buddy, Lt. Cmdr. Virgil Cole (Willem Dafoe), are two soldiers embedded in the Vietnam War growing frustrated by the military's constraints on their missions. Despite the best efforts of their commanding officer, Cmdr. Frank Camparelli (Danny Glover), to re-engage them, this disillusioned pair decide to take the war effort into their own hands with an explosive battle plan that could well get them court-martialed. - Danny Glover, Willem Dafoe, Brad Johnson, Rosanna Arquette, Tom Sizemore (War, Historical drama)

programme.title: Anthropoid
programme.desc: In December 1941, two Czech soldiers (Cillian Murphy, Jamie Dornan) parachute into their occupied homeland to assassinate Nazi officer Reinhard Heydrich (Detlef Bothe). - Cillian Murphy, Jamie Dornan, Charlotte Le Bon, Anna Geislerová, Toby Jones (Historical drama, War, Thriller)

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss. - Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem, Josh Brolin, Woody Harrelson, Kelly Macdonald (Crime drama, Thriller, Western)

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business. - Marlon Brando, Al Pacino, James Caan, Richard Castellano, Robert Duvall (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Godfather, Part II
programme.desc: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime. - Al Pacino, Robert Duvall, Diane Keaton, Robert De Niro, John Cazale (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: As Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) ages, he finds that being the head of the Corleone crime family isn't getting any easier. He wants his family out of the Mafia, but the mob kingpin (Eli Wallach) isn't eager to let one of the most powerful and wealthy families go legit. Making matters even worse is Michael's nephew, Vincent (Andy Garcia). Not only does Vincent want a piece of the Corleone family's criminal empire, but he also wants Michael's daughter, Mary (Sofia Coppola). - Al Pacino, Diane Keaton, Talia Shire, Andy Garcia, Eli Wallach (Crime drama)

programme.desc: Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an island where none should exist. Knowing that he will not be able to dissuade Sean from tracking the signal to its source, Hank, Sean's new stepfather, joins the teen on a quest to the South Pacific. Together with helicopter pilot Gabato and Gabato's feisty daughter, Kailani, they set out to find the island and rescue its sole human inhabitant. - Dwayne Johnson, Michael Caine, Josh Hutcherson, Vanessa Hudgens, Kristin Davis (Adventure, Fantasy, Action)

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: Working for a highly funded yet unofficial government agency, Kay and Jay are the Men in Black, providers of immigration services and regulators of all things alien on Earth. While investigating a series of unregistered close encounters, the MIB agents uncover the deadly plot of an intergalactic terrorist who is on a mission to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies currently in residence in New York City. - Tommy Lee Jones, Will Smith, Linda Fiorentino, Vincent D'Onofrio, Rip Torn (Action, Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Mystery)

programme.title: Men in Black 2
programme.desc: Kay and Jay reunite to provide our best line of defense against a seductress who levels the toughest challenge yet to the MIB's mission statement: protecting the earth from the scum of the universe. While investigating a routine crime, Jay uncovers a plot masterminded by Serleena, a Kylothian monster who disguises herself as a lingerie model. When Serleena takes the MIB building hostage, there is only one person Jay can turn to -- his former MIB partner. - Tommy Lee Jones, Will Smith, Rip Torn, Lara Flynn Boyle, Rosario Dawson (Action, Comedy, Science fiction)

programme.title: Men in Black 3
programme.desc: Even though agents J and K have been protecting the Earth from alien scum for many years, J still does not know much about his gruff partner. However, J soon gets an unexpected chance to find out what makes K tick when an alien criminal called Boris the Animal escapes, goes back to 1969, and kills K. With the fate of the planet at stake, J goes back in time and teams up with K's younger self to put things right. - Will Smith, Tommy Lee Jones, Josh Brolin, Jemaine Clement, Michael Stuhlbarg (Action, Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Mystery)

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: Daring, ruthless and meticulous, Parker (Jason Statham) is one of the most successful thieves in the business. But when his latest robbery turns deadly because of a careless crew member, he declines to join crime boss Melander (Michael Chiklis) and his gang for another heist. The crooks turn on Parker and leave him for dead. Parker survives and vows vengeance, tracing the gang to Palm Beach. There, he joins forces with an unlikely ally (Jennifer Lopez) to hijack the gang's next big score. - Jason Statham, Jennifer Lopez, Michael Chiklis, Wendell Pierce, Clifton Collins Jr. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Stealth
programme.desc: Navy fighter pilots Ben Gannon, Henry Purcell and Kara Wade are tasked with training an unmanned plane to hit important overseas targets. Ben doesn't trust the artificial-intelligence technology, especially after the plane is hit by lightning and rewired. However, the Navy is determined to put the plane in the air, even after it goes off on a mission of its own. Ben knows he has to stop the technology before it sparks a new world war. - Josh Lucas, Jessica Biel, Jamie Foxx, Sam Shepard, Joe Morton (Action, Thriller)

programme.desc: S1E10 - A passenger on board a wartime freighter has a premonition that the ship will be sunk by a Nazi submarine at 1:15 a.m., but no one believes him. - Nehemiah Persoff, Patrick Macnee, Leslie Bradley, Kendrick Huxham, Ben Wright (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - Hocus Pocus & Frisby

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - Dead Man's Shoes

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - The Invaders

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - The Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: S2E6 - A woman's natural beauty makes her a freak in a futuristic society. - Jennifer Howard, Joanna Heyes, William D. Gordon, Edson Stroll, Maxine Stuart (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - A Nice Place to Visit

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - The Man in the Bottle

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - Mr. Denton on Doomsday

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - And When the Sky Was Opened

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - Probe 7: Over & Out

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - Come Wander With Me
programme.desc: S5E34 - A popular folk singer persuades a backwoods girl to sing an authentic ballad into his tape recorder and finds the song coming tragically true. - Gary Crosby, Bonnie Beecher, Jonathan Bolt, Hank Patterson (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - In His Image

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - I Dream of Genie

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - Passage on the Lady Anne
programme.desc: S4E17 - A woman hopes a trans-Atlantic cruise and holiday in London will help save her marriage. - Gladys Cooper, Wilfrid Hyde-White, Cecil Kellaway, Lee Philips, Joyce Van Patten (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - Where Is Everybody?
programme.desc: S1E1 - An amnesiac (Earl Holliman) in an empty town feels he is being watched. - Earl Holliman, James Gregory, James McCallion, Jim Johnson, John Conwell (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - The Little People
programme.desc: S3E28 - A space traveler terrorizes the tiny inhabitants of a space station into accepting him as their God, but when another spaceship arrives the tyrannical man discovers everything is relative. - Joe Maross, Claude Akins, Robert Eaton, Michael Ford (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - Will the Real Martian Please Stand Up
programme.desc: S2E28 - On the night of a UFO sighting, seven people at a diner claim to be of Earth, though one of them is not. - Morgan Jones, Bill Kendis, John Archer, John Hoyt, Jean Willes (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - The Self-Improvement of Salvadore Ross

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - He's Alive

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - A World of Difference

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - Long Live Walter Jameson

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - Still Valley

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - Escape Clause

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - A Stop at Willoughby

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - A Passage for Trumpet
programme.desc: S1E32 - A down-on-his-luck trumpet player is given a second crack at life after being struck down by a truck. - Mary Webster, John Anderson, Jack Klugman, Frank Wolff, James Flavin (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - Kick the Can
programme.desc: S3E21 - An old man thinks children's games can restore youth. - Ernest Truex, Hank Patterson, Burt Mustin, Marjorie Bennett, Anne O'Neal (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - The Encounter
programme.desc: S5E31 - A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago. - Neville Brand, George Takei (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Twilight Zone - The Thirty-Fathom Grave

programme.desc: S1E2 - After toppling the Netherlands and Belgium, Nazi Germany pushes further west; the Allies scramble to support France as Churchill is forced to defend Britain from the skies and FDR rushes to mobilize wartime production. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Barbarossa
programme.desc: S1E3 - Examine the story of Operation Barbarossa, Hitler's surprise invasion of the Soviet Union in 1941, the largest and costliest land offensive in human history. (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Pearl Harbor
programme.desc: S1E4 - Japan escalates their war in China, drawing increasing U.S. sanctions and widespread outrage; driven by resource shortages and military ideology, Japan attacks Pearl Harbor in a move that reshapes the course of World War II. (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - The War at Sea
programme.desc: S1E5 - Examine how America's battle to control the seas against the German U-boats in the Atlantic and Japan's navy in the Pacific turns the tide of the war. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Guadalcanal
programme.desc: S1E6 - After the attack on Pearl Harbor, Japanese forces sweep across Southeast Asia; on Guadalcanal, United States Marines are given the bloody task of stopping their relentless advance. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Darkness Falls
programme.desc: S1E7 - As Hitler's reach extends beyond Germany and darkness descends on Europe, his hateful rhetoric leads to anti-Jewish persecution and ultimately, genocide. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Operation Torch
programme.desc: S1E8 - The first joint U.S.-British offensive of the war, thousands of inexperienced U.S. troops and their untested leader Eisenhower, face off against the hardened German Afrika Korps and the infamous Field Marshal Erwin Rommel. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: S1E9 - Behind the fierce frontline clashes of WWII, a hidden battle rages - one of espionage, deception, and codebreaking; in rural England, a group of brilliant academics work to crack Germany's unbreakable Enigma Code and change the course of the war. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Stalingrad

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Italy
programme.desc: S1E11 - The Allies hope to quickly penetrate the Nazi Reich via Italy but instead endure a months-long slog with devastating results. (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: S1E12 - Allied air forces engage in a fierce and costly battle with the German Luftwaffe over the skies of Europe. (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: Sportsnet World Highlights
programme.desc: A look at the best stories from around the world of sports. (Anthology)

programme.title: Things We Lost in the Fire
programme.desc: After her husband dies in an act of senseless violence, Audrey Burke (Halle Berry) is left alone with two young children and no idea how to cope. Nearly paralyzed by grief, Audrey tracks down her husband's childhood friend, Jerry (Benicio del Toro). Jerry is a drug addict, but Audrey invites him to move into her home nevertheless, and a mutually dependent relationship develops between the two damaged souls. - Halle Berry, Benicio del Toro, David Duchovny, Alison Lohman, Omar Benson Miller (Drama)

programme.title: Four Letters of Love
programme.desc: Nicholas and Isabel are made for each other, but as destiny pulls them together, family, passion and faith drives them apart. As they embark on journeys of heartache and misplaced love, fate soon contrives to pull the threads of their lives together. - Pierce Brosnan, Helena Bonham Carter, Gabriel Byrne, Ann Skelly, Fionn O'Shea (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Pete (Topher Grace), the quirky, self-deprecating manager of a grocery store, is madly in love with his best friend, Rosalee (Kate Bosworth). Unfortunately, she has absolutely no idea. When Rosalee wins a date with her favorite actor, the smarmy Tad Hamilton (Josh Duhamel), Pete delays admitting his feelings to her. And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. - Kate Bosworth, Topher Grace, Josh Duhamel, Nathan Lane, Sean Hayes (Romance, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Steel Magnolias
programme.desc: M'Lynn (Sally Field) is the mother of bride-to-be Shelby Eatenton (Julia Roberts), and as friend Truvy Jones (Dolly Parton) fixes the women's hair for the ceremony, they welcome a helping hand from aspiring beautician Annelle Dupuy DeSoto (Daryl Hannah). Diabetic Shelby has a health scare, which is averted but doesn't bode well for her hopes of having children. Time passes, and the women and their friends encounter tragedy and good fortune, growing stronger and closer in the process. - Sally Field, Dolly Parton, Shirley MacLaine, Daryl Hannah, Olympia Dukakis (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Nine
programme.desc: Italian film director Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) grapples with epic crises in his personal and professional lives. At the same time, he must strike a balance of the demands of numerous women in his life, including his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz), and his confidant (Judi Dench). - Daniel Day-Lewis, Marion Cotillard, Penélope Cruz, Judi Dench, Fergie (Musical, Romance)

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody... - Neve Campbell, David Arquette, Courteney Cox, Matthew Lillard, Skeet Ulrich (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: Murders draw a young woman (Neve Campbell), a reporter (Courteney Cox Arquette) and an ex-policeman (David Arquette) to the set of a movie inspired by horrific events that they survived.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: An old and mysterious camcorder leads to the discovery of a supernatural terror in a family's new home.

programme.title: Pretty Red Dress
programme.desc: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress.

programme.title: La Madrina: The Savage Life of Lorine Padilla
programme.desc: Lorine Padilla joins a street gang in the Bronx, N.Y., before becoming an activist and spiritual adviser.

programme.title: All the World Is Sleeping
programme.desc: A young mother in New Mexico sinks deeper into addiction while struggling to care for her daughter.

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career, A transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children.

programme.title: Boys and Girls
programme.desc: Two longtime friends (Freddie Prinze Jr., Claire Forlani), each with a string of failed romances, wonder if they should date each other.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: A married Chicago attorney (Richard Gere) takes dancing lessons with a beautiful woman (Jennifer Lopez) he saw through a window.

programme.title: Chasing Amy
programme.desc: A young cartoonist falls for a fellow artist, a lesbian with a long list of former lovers, creating an unexpected relationship.

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: As if creating the perfect Christmas for their families isn't hard enough, under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla will have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers during the holidays.

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: The mayor opposes a single mother (Juliette Binoche) who is opening a chocolate shop in his 1950s French village across from a church during Lent.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: A teen bounty hunter is torn between helping or capturing a seductive fugitive bank robber hiding in his small town during the Great Depression.

programme.title: The Dead Don't Hurt
programme.desc: When the man she loves, Holger Olsen, goes off to fight in the Civil War, Vivienne Le Coudy must fend for herself in a place controlled by a corrupt mayor and his unscrupulous business partner.

programme.title: The Reader
programme.desc: Michael Berg (David Kross), a teen in postwar Germany, begins a passionate but clandestine affair with Hanna Schmitz (Kate Winslet), an older woman who enjoys having classic novels read to her. Then Hanna mysteriously disappears, leaving Michael heartbroken and confused. Years later, Michael, now a law student, gets the shock of his life when he sees Hanna on trial for Nazi war crimes. - Kate Winslet, Ralph Fiennes, David Kross, Lena Olin, Bruno Ganz (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: The Violent Heart
programme.desc: Long-buried secrets threaten to tear a couple apart. - Jovan Adepo, Grace Van Patten, Lukas Haas, Mary J. Blige, Kimberly Williams-Paisley (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Cusp
programme.desc: In a small military town in Texas, three spirited teenage girls live out a fever-dream summer. Through their characters, photographers and debut filmmakers Parker Hill and Isabel Bethencourt share a fascinating glimpse into authentic American girlhood, where the strictures of adolescence clash with the growing desire for personal agency. (Documentary)

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt. - Alexandra Grey, David Beck, Jacob Moran, Hudson Paul, Fiona Morgan Quinn (Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: Big Night
programme.desc: Chef Primo and businessman Secondo are immigrant brothers from Italy who open their dream restaurant, Paradise, in New Jersey. However, Primo's authentic food is too unfamiliar for the local tastes, and the restaurant is struggling. When famous Italian-American bandleader Louis Prima is scheduled to appear at Paradise, the two brothers put all of their efforts into the important meal, which will likely decide the fate of their restaurant. - Minnie Driver, Ian Holm, Isabella Rossellini, Tony Shalhoub, Stanley Tucci (Drama)

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: An eight-year-old Amish boy witnesses a drug-related murder in a Philadelphia train station. The Philadelphia police captain discovers that the murderers are cops trying to squelch a corruption investigation. - Harrison Ford, Kelly McGillis, Alexander Godunov, Josef Sommer, Lukas Haas (Crime drama, Romance, Thriller)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. - Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche, Willem Dafoe, Kristin Scott Thomas, Naveen Andrews (Romance, War, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. - Matt Damon, Gwyneth Paltrow, Jude Law, Cate Blanchett, Philip Seymour Hoffman (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance)

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters. - Helen Mirren, Jason Clarke, Sarah Snook, Angus Sampson, Laura Brent (Horror, Thriller, Biography, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery. - Naomi Watts, Martin Henderson, David Dorfman, Brian Cox, Jane Alexander (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: A female journalist (Naomi Watts) must prevent evil Samara from taking possession of her son's (David Dorfman) soul. - Naomi Watts, Simon Baker, David Dorfman, Elizabeth Perkins, Gary Cole (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her. - Scarlett Johansson, Pilou Asbæk, "Beat" Takeshi Kitano, Michael Carmen Pitt, Juliette Binoche (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Strange Darling
programme.desc: Nothing is what it seems when a twisted one-night stand spirals into a serial killer's vicious murder spree. - Willa Fitzgerald, Kyle Gallner, Ed Begley Jr., Barbara Hershey, Steven Michael Quezada (Thriller, Horror)

programme.title: Would You Rather
programme.desc: Iris (Brittany Snow) and seven other desperate people become trapped in Shepard's (Jeffrey Combs) mansion. Shepard forces them to play a sadistic game for a large sum of money -- but the dilemmas become increasingly deadly. - Brittany Snow, Jeffrey Combs, Jonny Coyne, Lawrence Gilliard Jr., Enver Gjokaj (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Zona's Awesome Fishing Show
programme.desc: The unpredictable nature of fishing is why the sport is, well, awesome. That's the opinion of former professional angler Mark Zona, who demonstrates on his Outdoor Channel show the allure of not knowing what's going to happen with each cast. Episodes might start with a targeted species, but that's where the scripts end. What happens after that -- the successes and the failures, the magic and the miseries, the ecstasies and the agonies -- keep viewers guessing on what the next bite may bring. Zona's TV career began in 2005 as the co-host of "Loudmouth Bass." He has also provided analysis on Bassmaster tournament telecasts. (Outdoors, Fishing)

programme.title: Beyond the Blind Hunts - Prairie Giants
programme.desc: S1E1 - Host Justin Lilley travels to Saskatchewan's prairie landscape in pursuit of one of North America's most iconic big game animals, the bison. (Hunting)

programme.title: The Way It Was TV - WTL
programme.desc: The WTL banquet takes center stage, providing the majority of the funds needed to spread the message of Jesus Christ across the world. (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: Trigger Time Tv - Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A: Performance Mode B: Karl's BCM/G-Force Jawbone SBR C: 1895 Winchester D: Barricade Shooting. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Dream Makers - Crazy Hunting Montage Compilation
programme.desc: S6E1 - On this episode, we are doing a compilation of the best hunts from our last season as we meet up with a bunch of recipients going on a variety of hunts. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Offroad Odyssey - Cali Crawlin'
programme.desc: Friends from season 2 take Alexa crawling through the Sierra Nevada Mountains. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Long Range Hunter - Epic Hunt in South Africa - Part 1
programme.desc: S6E1 - This week, the moment has finally arrived as Pierre and his friends travel to Lakeside Safari in South Africa for an epic hunting trip. (Hunting)

programme.title: Hit Squad Outdoors With Tim Sylvia - Tim's Buck
programme.desc: This week Tim Sylvia goes after a big buck in his home state that he has been watching. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Reel West Coast - Tofino SFI Best Practices
programme.desc: S9E7 - For the last few years, Reel West Coast has been participating in a joint UBC-led study out of Barkley Sound. The study aims to determine the best practices for releasing sport caught salmon and ensuring their survival after catch and release. - Brendan Morrison (Fishing, Adventure, Travel)

programme.title: Trailing the Hunter's Moon - Bulls of Trans-Pecos
programme.desc: S8E1 - Blake Barnett heads to the Trans-Pecos region of Texas to hunt one of North America's most regal of animals, bull elk. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: The Chase with Ted and Amber - Archery Opener
programme.desc: S10E1 - Watch as The Chase Crew has a little fun in the historic town of Cass, West Virginia before heading to Texas for the archery opener. (Hunting)

programme.title: Northeast Untamed - My First Waterfowl Hunt
programme.desc: S1E1 - This year, Ben is learning to hunt with the help of some seasoned outdoorsmen; this week he's headed into the corn fields of New Brunswick for his first waterfowl hunt. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles With Curtis Fleming - Thank You, Doc!
programme.desc: Our good friend, FRC Staff & Retired US Marine Veteran thinks he is going to The Lodge at Chama to work, but the FRC Crew & friends have a different plan for Doc this week on America's Birthday. (Outdoors, Fishing)

programme.title: DeerTopia - Crafting a Whitetail Paradise
programme.desc: S5E13 - Steve Bartylla shows how to maximize the tools one already has and make the most of any hunting situation. (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: How to Hunt With Ryan Kohler - Ryan Kohlers Biggest Black Bear
programme.desc: S8E2 - Ryan Kohler gets an opportunity to harvest his biggest black bear yet; will everything come together for the perfect shot, or will this giant slip away? (Hunting, Outdoors, Reality)

programme.title: The Canadian Tradition - The Start, Part 1
programme.desc: S17E1 - Join host Taylor Wright on a family outdoor adventure; Taylor heads to the field with his daughters on a spring Wild Turkey hunt. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Savage Outdoors - Roar
programme.desc: S16E2 - It's spring time in Texas and the axis are starting to roar at the ranches. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail - New Dirt (New)
programme.desc: S16E1 - Magnus Partridge coming off a HUGE velvet drop-tine monster heads back into the Saskatchewan Deer woods to try to line up on another Mature buck. (Adventure, Outdoors)

programme.title: The Wild Outdoors - Archer Lee (New)
programme.desc: S34E1 - Following Archer Lee and his dad, Mac in Missouri chasing deer and turkeys. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Prairie Pursuit - Sandspit Adventures! (New)
programme.desc: S9E8 - Greg takes the family to the Canadian West Coast island of Haida Gwaii for everyone's very first ocean adventure. (Hunting, Fishing)

programme.title: CCFR Radio: On the Air (New)
programme.desc: S5E21 - Rod Giltaca from the Canadian Coalition for Firearm Rights (CCFR) and guests explore firearm-related topics and rights in a current events show. (Talk, Public affairs)

programme.title: The Edge - No Easy Mountain (New)
programme.desc: S16E8 - After a successful mountain caribou hunt, Joe Eppeles' remote fly-in adventure continues; pursuing stone sheep and goats in extreme heat, Joe and Kyle push into new terrain until a final opportunity changes everything. - Joe Eppele (Outdoors)

programme.title: My Best Hunt with Rod Giltaca - Blue Sky Mulie
programme.desc: S2E1 - Skyler Johnston returns to share an incredible solo Mulie hunt with Rod. (Hunting)

programme.title: Outdoor Quest - Muskox on the Barrens
programme.desc: Hunting muskox and fishing for giant lake trout at Aylmer Lake. (Fishing, Hunting)

programme.title: How to Hunt With Ryan Kohler - Ryan Kohlers Biggest Black Bear
programme.desc: S8E2 - Ryan Kohler gets an opportunity to harvest his biggest black bear yet; will everything come together for the perfect shot, or will this giant slip away? (Hunting, Outdoors, Reality)

programme.title: Game On With Blaine Anthony - Gator Aid
programme.desc: Blaine heads to Florida for his yearly Gator and Hog hunt. Blaine finally gets a tag for a lake he has been wanting to gator hunt on, but it turns out to be much harder than expected.

programme.title: Born to Hunt - The Widow Maker
programme.desc: Eric Marion is surprised by a Cape Buffalo hunt, one of Africa's most feared beasts; the team tracks the legendary animal with help from Lakeside Safari's professional hunters. (Outdoors, Adventure, Hunting)

programme.title: Prairie Pursuit - Sandspit Adventures!
